thesis: The market is in a high-confidence risk-off regime (QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, VIX at the 0.858 percentile, tech and semis leading the decline), and buying a stock that is up 37% over 63 days into that tape is poor timing. The post-earnings catalyst has already played out. The price sits about 4% under a 31.00 high that was rejected on the heaviest volume of the period, and it trades well above the 24.5 mean analyst target (hold-rated). Volume is light (vol_ratio 0.91), so there is no fresh accumulation, and the trade needs a clean break above 31 to reach the 32.6 target. Cash conversion is weak (FCF 9.2M against 37.8M net income) and leverage is elevated. The 21.7% short interest cuts both ways, and in a falling market it means sharp, unpredictable reversals. Waiting for a pullback toward SMA20 or SMA50 offers a better entry.
